projectState.summary: Byte 9b is implemented and ready for Claude review. The app now has a browser-side local Ollama boundary for health checks and one manual melody thought probe, configurable base/model settings, a session primer that documents scaleDegree/octave/sourceStartBeat/placement conventions, raw/parsed/validated inspector output, an influence-probe prompt fixture, and deterministic mock fallback. Model output remains inspection-only and is not scheduled into transport, lookahead, taste, or session behavior.
